objective: Review the definition-only execution boundary after accepted native-parser handoff-contract-to-operator-plan metadata hardening, decide whether a later run gate may execute a narrow reviewed sidecar build/run/compare sequence, and keep this review from claiming command execution, RTL simulation, compare execution, measured timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, or native Verilator support.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough for a later run gate because it admits only ready operator-plan metadata from the reviewed fixture, requires all non-execution flags to be false before any command can run, requires a reviewed or regenerated sidecar stage plan with explicit stage order, keeps direct-looking Verilator command metadata as preview/build input rather than sidecar runtime evidence, and keeps coverage_output_equivalence as a future compare result rather than evidence from this definition.
review_decision.weakest_point: The handoff_contract and command_argv metadata can be over-read as authority because command_argv starts with a Verilator-like command while the stage plan still decides what may actually run. The accepted boundary therefore permits only a scoped sidecar build/run/compare execution derived from reviewed metadata and a reviewed or regenerated stage plan; it does not permit arbitrary filelist dependency inference, automatic GPU allocation, measured timing, speedup, raw full-state equality, or broad native parser support claims.

required_next_gate.name: run_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_handoff_contract_operator_plan_sidecar_execution_gate
